name: instagram-stack
description: 15 Instagram skills for Claude Code and Codex, merged from two MIT bundles: niche reading via Apify, caption and carousel writing against 26 documented hook formulas, a 199-entry anti-slop humaniser that returns its own replacements, reel and story scripting, profile scoring on a 12-criterion rubric, weekly planning, and comment and reply drafting. Publishing goes through an approval gate that is enforced at runtime, not merely documented: nothing reaches a provider without a live, payload-bound approval, and the bundle is read-only until armed from the launch environment.
